a.OUT=OUT;snap=OUT/'screen-source-snapshots';snap.mkdir()
for n in ['tests/cuda/trellis35_operator_lab.cu','tests/cuda/trellis35_operator_candidates.cu','tests/cuda/trellis35_t3_gate_pipeline_candidate.cuh','tests/cuda/trellis35_m1_eight_warp_candidate.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/t3_gate_pair_codec.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/t3_gate_pair_window.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/t3_down_pair_window.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/m1_gate_pair_window.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/mma_w4a8.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/codec.cuh','src/cuda/trellis35/detail/h128_warp.cuh']:
 p=snap/n;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(ROOT/n,p)
cmd=['/opt/cuda/bin/nvcc','-std=c++20','-O3','--generate-code=arch=compute_120a,code=[compute_120a,sm_120a]','-rdc=true','--expt-relaxed-constexpr','-Xcompiler','-fPIC','-shared','--cudart','shared','-I'+str(ROOT/'include'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'src'),'-I'+str(ROOT/'third_party'),str(ROOT/'tests/cuda/trellis35_operator_lab.cu'),str(ROOT/'tests/cuda/trellis35_operator_candidates.cu'),str(OUT/'omitted_attention_stub.cu'),'-o',str(OUT/'operator-lab-rdc.so'),'-ldl']
a.record('build-lab-rdc',cmd,180)
a.record('lab-resources',['cuobjdump','--dump-resource-usage',str(OUT/'operator-lab-rdc.so')],30)
base=json.loads((ROOT/'benchmarks/results/2026-10-22/c0a807af/operator-replay/native-t3-capture-v2.command.json').read_text());base[0]=str(OUT/'native-replay-parent')
results={}
for depth in [2,4,0]:
 name=('bounded2' if depth==0 else 'depth'+str(depth))+'-rdc-screen';env=os.environ.copy();env.update(GEM16_VISION_D2_DIAGNOSTIC='1',LD_PRELOAD=str(OUT/'operator-lab-rdc.so'),GEM16_TRELLIS35_OPERATOR_LAB='1',GEM16_LAB_MODE='t3',GEM16_LAB_CANDIDATE=('t3-gate-bound2' if depth==0 else 't3-gate-pipe'+str(depth)),GEM16_LAB_OUTPUT=str(OUT/(name+'-operators')))
 (OUT/(name+'.environment.json')).write_text(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith('GEM16_') or k=='LD_PRELOAD'},indent=2)+'\n')
 a.record(name,base,180,env);assert '2097152 lane cases, mismatches=0' in (OUT/(name+'.stderr.log')).read_text()
 d=json.loads((OUT/(name+'-operators/captures.json')).read_text());assert len(d['cases'])==24 and all(c['projection_bit_exact'] and c['candidate_eight_warp_bit_exact'] for c in d['cases'])
 gains=[]
 for c in d['cases']:
  if c['stem'].endswith('gate'):
   gain=statistics.median(c['parent_us_samples'])/statistics.median(c['candidate_us_samples'])-1;gains.append(gain)
   print(depth,c['stem'],'gain',gain,flush=True)
 results[str(depth)]={'min_gain':min(gains),'median_gain':statistics.median(gains),'max_gain':max(gains),'all_bit_exact':True,'eligible_for_full_qualification':min(gains)>.02}
 print('DEPTH',depth,results[str(depth)],flush=True)
(OUT/'screen-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
